rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved providers: psychological associations recognized by the profession (or providers they approve), mental health/health/psychoeducational associations, regionally accredited institutions, government agencies, licensed hospitals/facilities, providers approved by another state's psychology board
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt from continuing competency requirements for the first renewal after initial licensure by examination in Virginia.
rules.carryover: Up to 7 hours above the 14 may be carried forward to the next annual renewal.
rules.audit_note: Random audits after each renewal period; keep original documentation for 4 years.

topics.who: All licensees: ethics, laws and regulations governing psychology, incl. standards of practice

rules.notes: At least 6 hours face-to-face or real-time interactive. Up to 4 hours each for presenting, publishing, journal editing; 2 hours for licensing board membership; up to 2 hours via volunteer services (3:1). Applies to all license categories under 18VAC125-20.
